components.css: .ds-row{display:flex;gap:25px;padding:24px;border-bottom:1px solid #292724;background:#faf7f5;color:#111;transition:background .2s ease,color .2s ease}.ds-row:hover,.ds-row:focus-within{background:#111;color:#fff}.ds-number{font:13px 'DM Sans',sans-serif}.ds-title{font:22px 'PT Serif',Georgia,serif}.ds-row p{font:14px/1.55 'PT Serif',Georgia,serif}.ds-row a{color:inherit;font:600 11px 'DM Sans',sans-serif}.ds-row a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #a56b42;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: A restrained, warm paper canvas carries a spacious typographic portfolio. Thin rules and numbered rows provide the structure, while a bilingual reveal and small pixel-art character add personality. The visual reference is MiMo; the content and character are Harsh's own.
keyCharacteristics: Warm monochrome surfaces and fine black dividing lines.
Bold sans-serif headlines paired with readable serif copy.
Large editorial spacing, numbered rows, and a typographic interlude.
Playful motion with explicit touch and keyboard alternatives.
dos: Do preserve the warm paper and ink contrast and the thin structural rules.
Do give section headings generous space and keep descriptive copy readable.
Do provide keyboard and touch access to interactions and respect reduced motion.
Do use the supplied pixel character sparingly as an interactive detail.
donts: Don't replace the bilingual reveal with an interaction available only to a pointer.
Don't turn the numbered editorial rows into heavy rounded cards.
Don't rely on color alone to communicate focus or error states.
